title: Hitzzy Zingy Soup
description: A refreshing and light soup made with the unique flavors of hitzzy and zingy, perfect for a warm day.
instructions: Heat a large bowl over medium heat.
Add 2 cups of hitzzy and 1 cup of zingy to the bowl.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in 2 cups of canh and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with tangerine juice to taste.
Garnish with additional tangerine slices, if desired.
